tooltip.essentialcraft5.soul_stone.align.en: A Neutral matrix has no Alignment. Change its type with a Matrix Projection.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.soul_stone.align.zh: 中性矩阵没有相性，用矩阵投影换一种属性

tooltip.essentialcraft5.soul_stone.sipho.en: Siphon: sneak and hold use on an MRUCU within %2$s blocks to draw up to %1$s MRU
tooltip.essentialcraft5.soul_stone.sipho.zh: 虹吸：潜行，对着 %2$s 格内的聚集体按住右键，一次最多抽 %1$s MRU

tooltip.essentialcraft5.alignment.chaos.en: Your melee and projectile hits deal %1$s%% more damage

tooltip.essentialcraft5.alignment.frozen.en: Melee damage you take is %1$s%% lower; anything that lands a melee hit on you freezes deeper (+%2$s, frozen solid at 140)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.alignment.frozen.zh: 你受到的近战伤害 −%1$s%%，近战打中你的活物冻得更深（+%2$s，攒到 140 冻僵）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.alignment.magic.en: This mod's handheld and worn items use %1$s%% less MRU; Siphon cap +%2$s%%
tooltip.essentialcraft5.alignment.magic.zh: 本模组随身物品耗 MRU −%1$s%%，虹吸上限 +%2$s%%

tooltip.essentialcraft5.alignment.shade.en: Magic damage from an attacker is %1$s%% lower

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.en: Matrix Trait: from Alignment I, hits that land trigger an effect of your matrix type (%1$s MRU each)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.zh: 矩阵特性：有相性以后，打实时按你的矩阵属性触发，每次 %1$s MRU

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.mul.en: This weapon's Matrix Trait is %1$s times as strong

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.ina.en: You have no Alignment yet (Matrix Rank 3 and a matrix that isn't Neutral)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.ina.zh: 你还没有相性（要矩阵三阶，矩阵不能是中性）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.cha.en: the target can't heal for %1$s s; +%2$s%% damage to targets that already can't
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.cha.zh: 目标 %1$s 秒内回不了血；对已经回不了血的目标多打 %2$s%%

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.fro.en: the target freezes deeper (+%1$s, frozen solid at 140); +%2$s%% damage to targets frozen solid
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.fro.zh: 目标冻得更深（+%1$s，攒到 140 冻僵）；对冻僵的目标多打 %2$s%%

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.mag.en: strips one beneficial effect, at most once every %1$s s per target
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.mag.zh: 剥掉目标一个增益效果，同一个目标每 %1$s 秒最多一次

tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.sha.en: heals you for %1$s%% of the damage dealt
tooltip.essentialcraft5.matrix_trait.sha.zh: 这一下伤害的 %1$s%% 回给你

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_siphon.do.zh: 虹吸抽到 %1$s MRU，矩阵容量 %2$s / %3$s

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_siphon.no.en: No MRUCU within %2$s blocks in front of you
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_siphon.no.zh: 面前 %2$s 格内没有聚集体

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_siphon.st.en: An Enrichment Chamber stabilizer is holding this MRUCU; you can't siphon it
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_siphon.st.zh: 这团聚集体被富集仓的稳定器压着，抽不动

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_siphon.de.en: This MRUCU is somewhere you don't have permission to change
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_siphon.de.zh: 这团聚集体在你没有权限改动的地方

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_siphon.em.en: This MRUCU has no MRU left
